summary.en: A warm wood-look arrangement with the mirror and small-item storage together.

description.en:
A woodgrain-look dressing table shown with an upright mirror and storage arranged around the upper section. The coordinated appearance is a starting point for a warmer bedroom palette.
Confirm the exact finish, dimensions, hardware and stool requirements with your selected model.

木纹外观梳妆台配有竖向镜面及上部收纳布局，可作为暖色卧室配色的选款方向。
具体饰面、尺寸、五金与坐凳需求按所选款式核对。

en: Mirror and upper storage in one arrangement.

zh: 可与其他卧室家具核对配色。
